item.title: Highlight the sentence being spoken on the source page
item.problem: The reader does not show which source-page sentence is currently being spoken, so the owner cannot visually follow playback in the article.
item.desiredOutcome: The source page visibly and accessibly highlights the actual sentence being spoken and keeps that highlight synchronized through the supported playback lifecycle.

completionCriteria.text: Define and test normalized source-text-to-DOM mapping that identifies the intended sentence without corrupting or losing the article’s structure.
Make the sentence highlight follow actual playback through supported pause, seek, replay and resume behavior, and clear it on stop, error or navigation.
Support the native route only to the precision established by PL-23’s boundary-capability result, without presenting timer guesses as precise speech position.
Complete accessible visual QA on a full source page and on selected text, including readable focus, contrast and cleanup behavior.

item.nextAction: Managed task 01a09cda-534e-7ee2-81cd-90469f044618 in /Users/ioannism/.codex/worktrees/c525/tts-chrome starts normalized source-text/DOM mapping and Kokoro sentence highlighting now, including highlight lifecycle and accessible page/selection QA. Only the native-boundary adapter depends on PL-23’s capability result. The coordinator owns the cross-task engine/protocol contract and will serialize audible or GPU QA.
